svg.aria-label: Where are green jobs? Two groups of four illustrated cards linked by a central leaf badge. Traditional sectors: Agriculture (a farmer drives a tractor past rows of crops and wheat), Manufacturing (a worker in a hard hat beside a conveyor belt carrying boxes in front of a factory), Construction (a tower crane lifts a steel beam over a building site while a worker in a hard hat checks a plan), and Administration (an office worker at a desk with a laptop showing a chart and a leaf, and a stack of documents). New and emerging green sectors: Renewable energy (wind turbines and solar panels in the sun), Energy efficiency (an insulated house where heat arrows bounce back inside, and an LED bulb), Recycling and waste (three recycling bins under a recycling symbol of three chasing arrows), and Research (R&D) (a microscope, a flask with a growing leaf and test tubes on a lab bench). Footer: Shared goals: protect nature, cut pollution and waste, use less energy and water, decent work.
svg.title: Where are green jobs?
svg.text: Shared goals: protect nature · cut pollution and waste · use less energy and water · decent work
